Komponenten støtter også de felles egenskapene [`id`](../common-properties/#id), [`hidden`](../common-properties/#hidden), [`grid`](../grid/) og [`pageBreak`](../page-break/).

| Egenskap                                     | Type                                                                                                         | Påkrevd | Standardverdi | Beskrivelse                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `type`                                       | `"CustomButton"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               | Angir hvilken komponenttype konfigurasjonen gjelder.                                                                               |
| `actions`                                    | `(object \| object \| object \| object \| object)[]`                                                         | Ja      |               | Handlingene som kjøres når brukeren velger knappen.                                                                                |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].id`              | `"nextPage"`                                                                                                 | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].type`            | `"ClientAction"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation`      | `object`                                                                                                     | Nei     |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation.page` | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Ja      |               | Angir hvilke sider som skal valideres når brukeren velger neste-knappen. Tillatte verdier: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation.show` | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Ja      |               | Liste over valideringstypene som skal vises.                                                                                       |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].id`              | `"previousPage"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].type`            | `"ClientAction"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation`      | `object`                                                                                                     | Nei     |               |                                                                                                                                    |

Tillatte verdier: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation.show` | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Ja      |               | Liste over valideringstypene som skal vises.                                                                                       |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].id`              | `"navigateToPage"`                                                                                           | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].type`            | `"ClientAction"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |

| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation.page` | `"current" \| "currentAndPrevious" \| "all"`                                                                 | Ja      |               | Angir hvilke sider som skal valideres når brukeren velger neste-knappen. Tillatte verdier: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].validation.show` | `"Schema" \| "Component" \| "Expression" \| "CustomBackend" \| "Required" \| "AllExceptRequired" \| "All"[]` | Ja      |               | Liste over valideringstypene som skal vises.                                                                                       |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].metadata`        | `object`                                                                                                     | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].metadata.page`   | `string`                                                                                                     | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ClientAction].id`              | `"closeSubform"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |

Tillatte verdier: "current", "currentAndPrevious", "all". |

| `actions[type=ServerAction].id`              | `string`                                                                                                     | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ServerAction].type`            | `"ServerAction"`                                                                                             | Ja      |               |                                                                                                                                    |
| `actions[type=ServerAction].validation`      | `object`                                                                                                     | Nei     |               |                                                                                                                                    |

| `buttonStyle`                                | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary"`                                                                     | Nei     | `"secondary"` | Knappens stil eller fargepalett. Tillatte verdier: "primary", "secondary", "tertiary".                                             |
| `buttonColor`                                | `"first" \| "second" \| "success" \| "danger"`                                                               | Nei     |               | Knappens fargepalett. Tillatte verdier: "first", "second", "success", "danger".                                                    |
| `buttonSize`                                 | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "small" \| "medium" \| "large"`                                                     | Nei     |               | Knappens størrelse. Tillatte verdier: "sm", "md", "lg", "small", "medium", "large".                                                |
| `textResourceBindings`                       | `object`                                                                                                     | Nei     |               | Kobler tekstene i komponenten til tekstressurser eller uttrykk.                                                                    |
| `textResourceBindings.title`                 | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                               | Nei     |               | Teksten på knappen.                                                                                                                |
| `textResourceBindings.tableTitle`            | `string \| expression<string>`                                                                               | Nei     |               | Knappeteksten når knappen vises i en tabell.                                                                                       |
